parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123859. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL1123859. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
